cohort: 10,034 pregnant women with pregestational diabetes mellitus
finding: Pregnant women with pregestational diabetes experienced different pregnancy outcomes depending on their age group, with teenagers having higher risk for preeclampsia and LGA neonates, and women aged 35-39 years at higher risk for cesarean delivery and IUFD.
mod_finding: Women aged 35-39 years with pregestational diabetes were at higher risk for cesarean delivery compared to the reference group (20-34 years).
